name: econsoc-template-plugins
description: Build inputs for the bundled MyST plugins in this directory. Authors need none of this: myst.yml loads the committed bundles.
comment: Exact versions, not ranges: they are bundled into proof-kinds.mjs. myst-to-tex 1.0.48 and unified 10.1.2 are the versions mystmd 1.12.0 (myst-cli 1.12.0) ships; build.mjs applies jupyter-book/mystmd PR 3031 to myst-to-tex.
